verdict.rationale: Apify provides a CLI and 'software toolkits for developing new Actors' plus a large marketplace of 64,279 pre-built Actors, which functionally lets developers start from existing building blocks, but the evidence never explicitly documents a curated 'project template' gallery or scaffolding command with named starter templates. Missing for 10: explicit template gallery/documentation, CLI scaffolding command details (e.g., 'apify create' template list), independent confirmation of ease-of-start experience.
